turns.customer: Hi, the Riverwalk sandals in order #1376 are a size too big. I only tried them on indoors. How do I send them back?
turns.reply: You can return the Riverwalk Camp Sandal because it’s still in an unused condition. Log in to your account, go to the order details for #1376, and select the return option to generate a prepaid return label. Pack the sandals in their original packaging, attach the label, and drop the package off at the carrier. The return must be received by 2026‑10‑11; once the warehouse processes it, your refund will be issued. Let us know if you need any further help.
